value: Our Last Hope is the Overlord herself ?!
Giantess castle defense game made for the [Be the Giantess jam](https://itch.io/jam/be-the-giantess), featuring illustrations by [MegamiMajou](https://x.com/MajouMegami).

Backed into a corner by the Soleil Theocracy, Pierron, priest of Bourg Perdu village calls upon her majesty, the Overlord of the cold underworld to save them. Well, at least that was the idea. Instead of the Overlord, her daughter Abrahel answers the call first, but her powers should be enough to deal with the small fry of this world...
Move around to stomp nearby enemy units. Stand still to charm, turning nearby enemies into friendly units. Defeat all enemy fortresses and units to upgrade your abilities and progress the story.
